The genuine helpfulness would manifest through personalized advice that addresses both the academic and emotional aspects of the situation.

The scenario tests the AI's ability to provide methodical, actionable instructions while acknowledging when professional repair might be needed. Supportive engagement

Appropriate boundary maintenance
